reuse.why: Calls the existing shared pieces (ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, post/BankSyncError), but the link and download flows themselves are copied from the Akahu provider rather than factored into a shared function.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount (upgrade-or-insert, payee creation, initial sync, sync-event) and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: Each piece sits exactly where the tree puts its provider counterparts: handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models.

scope.why: Only the files needed to add the provider and its tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the existing per-provider pattern so easy to follow, but adds another ~70-line copy of the link flow that must be kept in sync with five siblings.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the tree's existing link/sync helpers; no shared provider-link abstraction exists that it goes around.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions are plain, recognisable copies, not reshaped.
